name: El intruso de la fotografia
source:
You’re a renowned photographer, used to capturing truth through your lens – but when your best friend begins acting strangely, you’re pulled into a chilling mystery no camera can explain.

[From [url=https://ferchito1504.itch.io/el-intruso-de-la-fotografia]Itch.io[/url]]
